deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) In vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py::NPUModelRunner.sample, inside the lmhead_tp_enable() branch after `logits = logits[:num_logits]` (around line 1239) and before the grammar bitmask/`apply_grammar_bitmask`, add the same masking as upstream: `if self.masked_token_ids is not None: logits.index_fill_(-1, self.masked_token_ids, float("-inf"))`. The default (non-lmhead-TP) branch already gets this via `super().sample()`, and `NPUModelRunner.__init__` calls `super().__init__`, so `self.masked_token_ids` is already created on `self.device`. Consider factoring the masking into a small helper so both branches and future re-syncs of the 'Dispatch tail mirrors GPUModelRunner.sample' comment (:1241) stay consistent. 2) In vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/model_runner.py::NPUModelRunner310V2.sample, after `logits = self.model.compute_logits(hidden_states[input_batch.logits_indices])` (line 1368) and before `apply_grammar_bitmask`, add the identical `index_fill_` masking; this class fully replaces sample() and otherwise silently ignores masked_token_ids on 310P. 3) No change is needed in xlite or the default MRV2 path beyond inheriting/using the base attribute; vllm-ascend only ships MRV2 (patch_use_v2_model_runner), so the new ModelConfig field and `--masked-token-ids` are inherited without EngineArgs/ModelConfig reconstruction. 4) Add Ascend-side coverage analogous to tests/v1/sample/test_masked_token_ids.py: a unit test driving NPUModelRunner.sample and NPUModelRunner310V2.sample with `masked_token_ids` set (covering both lmhead-TP on/off as feasible) to assert only the unmasked token can be sampled, and confirm the inherited SpeculativeConfig rejection for synthetic/fly still fires through vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_speculative_config.py. 5) Validate that the Ascend custom sampling ops (top-k/top-p/min-p/gumbel/penalties) handle logits rows with all-but-one entries set to -inf without NaN or fallback-token selection.
deep_analysis.risk: Low-to-medium. Default Ascend MRV2 behavior is correct by inheritance, so the main risk is a silent functional gap: the feature is user-visible via --masked-token-ids but is ignored on 310P entirely and on NPU lmhead-TP (finegrained_tp lmhead_tensor_parallel_size > 1), which could produce disallowed tokens without any error. The fix is small and runs in the eager sampling path after logits production, so it does not affect ACL graph capture (masked_token_ids is already in ModelConfig's compile ignored_factors upstream). Residual risk is numerical/edge behavior of Ascend's custom samplers on highly sparse -inf logits (e.g. top-p/min-p/gumbel), which is why an NPU-side sampling test is required; DP/TP collective row sizing (lmhead TP padding) is unaffected as masking is applied after the capacity trim.

deep_analysis.risk: Low. The fix is confined to the rope_2d branch of a shared vllm utility; rope_3d behavior is unchanged. The main residual risk is an assumption mismatch: the new sizing assumes the rope_2d tower pools all temporal frames (MoonViT `sd2_tpool`; output rows = h*w/(merge_h*merge_w)). Ascend currently uses upstream `MoonViT3dPretrainedModel` with that merger, so it matches, but any future custom Ascend Kimi vision merger that preserves frames (e.g. partial temporal merging) would be under-counted. Also, current Ascend e2e coverage only uses T=1 images, so a DP+video (T>1) regression test is needed to prevent silent recurrence. No numerical/kernel changes on the NPU side; only all-gather padding length and slicing offsets change, which improves correctness rather than altering valid outputs.

commits.comment: 修正 V2 Model Runner 全图捕获期间 forward context 的 runtime mode 语义：此前 CudaGraphManager 在 FULL 捕获时以 `CUDAGraphMode.NONE` 调用被捕获的 forward（使 in-model 的 PIECEWISE 包装保持 eager），导致模型代码里所有 `cudagraph_runtime_mode == FULL` 的守卫在捕获期永不命中，形成一堆 “MRV2 captures FULL graphs with runtime_mode=NONE” 的特例注释与绕过逻辑。本 commit 将 vllm/v1/worker/gpu/cudagraph_utils.py 的捕获调用改为 `forward_fn(CUDAGraphMode.FULL)`，把 in-model 的 BreakableCUDAGraphWrapper 显式构造为 `runtime_mode=CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE`（两处：通用 CudaGraphManager 与 DeepSeek V4.1 replay manager），并在 ubatch 路径上把 `context.cudagraph_runtime_mode = cg_mode` 写入每个 forward context，随后删除 deepseek_v41 / minimax_m3 / step5 中依赖旧语义的注释与跳过逻辑。风险：原先依赖“捕获期 mode 为 NONE（等同 eager/warmup）”的模型内分支现在会走 FULL 分支，任何遗漏的 site（尤其 OOT 平台复用的 model/patch 代码）可能在图中固化了本应 eager-only 的状态变更；新增的 BreakableCUDAGraphWrapper `runtime_mode` 关键字参数需所有复用该包装的调用点显式给出。

ascend_impact.functionality: 变更落在 vllm/v1/worker/gpu/cudagraph_utils.py（CudaGraphManager/ModelCudaGraphManager 的 FULL 捕获入口）与 BreakableCUDAGraphWrapper 的构造参数上。vllm-ascend 的 v2 model runner（vllm_ascend/worker/v2 与 patch_v2/patch_*_speculator.py）复用/补丁该 GPU v2 树，且 Ascend 侧模型与融合 pass 中存在以 `get_forward_context().cudagraph_runtime_mode` 判定 FULL/PIECEWISE/NONE 的分支（解码专用状态、stream capture 跳过逻辑），捕获期语义由 NONE 变为 FULL 后这些判定结果改变；若 Ascend 的 Breakable 图包装复用上游基类，还需显式传入 runtime_mode=PIECEWISE 以保持“in-model 包装在 FULL 图内 eager”的契约。
ascend_impact.testing: 需回归 Ascend v2 Model Runner 的 ACL Graph FULL 捕获用例，以及所有依赖 forward context runtime mode 的模型/融合分支（例如 decode-only 融合、CP/TP 路径的 capture 跳过条件）；同时检查 Breakable 图包装在 PIECEWISE 下的重放宽度用例。

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) Fix the concrete spec-decode break: vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/target_dependent_ar/aclgraph.py::AutoRegressiveAclGraphManager.capture passes AscendTargetDependentARSpeculator._multi_step_decode as the capture forward_fn. With this commit the manager now calls it with cg_mode=FULL, so speculator.py::_multi_step_decode takes the `batch_desc.cg_mode == FULL -> self.decode_cudagraph_manager.run_fullgraph(batch_desc)` branch while the graph is still being captured, when `self.graphs[desc]` does not exist (assert 'No cudagraph for desc'). Guard that branch with `not torch.npu.is_current_stream_capturing()` (or an explicit for_capture flag), or mirror upstream vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/autoregressive/speculator.py::capture which passes a capture-only `_decode`/`_fused_multi_step_decode` rather than the runtime multi-step dispatcher. Apply the same audit to vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/spec_decode/mtp_speculator.py (its run_fullgraph loop is safe only if the custom 310P capture path bypasses it). 2) In vllm_ascend/worker/v2/aclgraph_utils.py::ModelAclGraphManager.init_breakable_cg_runner, build BreakableACLGraphWrapper with runtime_mode=CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE, and extend vllm_ascend/compilation/breakable_aclgraph.py::BreakableACLGraphWrapper.__init__ to accept runtime_mode and forward it to BreakableCUDAGraphWrapper.__init__, mirroring upstream cudagraph_utils.py:624-629 and decoder_replay_cudagraph.py:59. Otherwise its default runtime_mode=None makes it match FULL during FULL capture and take its `is_full_capture` _capture/_replay branches instead of running eagerly under the outer FULL graph. 3) DeepSeek V4.1 Engram: vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v41/model.py (prepare_engram_inputs / prepare_engram_graph_inputs, lines ~1806-1817, 1881-1883, 1917-1926) and engram/model_state.py::prepare_attn now see forward_context mode FULL during capture. Note create_forward_fn sets batch_descriptor=None for FULL, so any ExternalEvent lookup keyed by context.batch_descriptor must instead use the padded token count (as prime_engram_v2_graph_inputs does), and reconcile that prepare_inputs_to_capture still calls prepare_attn(..., CUDAGraphMode.NONE, ...) while the forward context is FULL. 4) Audit attention/model gates that change branch during capture: vllm_ascend/attention/sfa_v1.py:2108 and indexer_kpool.py:1119 now take the FULL branch (previously capture was NONE); sfa_hisparse.py:40/56/647 and kimi_k3.py:134-153 contain comments/docs built on 'FULL capture runs as NONE' and must be updated/verified (kimi already has a stream-capturing guard; hisparse has hisparse_for_capture). 5) Add coverage for FULL-capture graphs: EAGLE/target-dependent AR and MTP with num_speculative_steps>1 (this is where the run_fullgraph-during-capture assertion appears), DFlash/DSpark, DeepSeek V4.1 Engram overlap, and breakable PIECEWISE; also update any tests asserting NONE during FULL capture. DBO itself needs no work because vllm_ascend/platform.py resets enable_dbo/ubatch_size to 0.
deep_analysis.risk: Medium-high correctness risk. The core semantics change is silent branch inversion for any code keyed on cudagraph_runtime_mode: capture now reports FULL, so incorrect guards can either assert (speculator run_fullgraph before graph insertion) or silently capture/replay a different graph than before, producing hangs, stale attention metadata or use-after-free in graph pools. The breakable-wrapper runtime_mode omission is low risk in the target-model path but becomes correctness-critical wherever the wrapper is reached under a FULL context. Engram ExternalEvent handling keyed on a None batch_descriptor is the most fragile area and can cause capture-time event collisions or missed waits. Mitigate with targeted FULL-mode unit tests plus e2e runs for EAGLE/MTP K>1, DFlash/DSpark, DeepSeek V4.1 Engram and Hisparse/SFA before syncing vllm.
